Nashik's industrial base — Satpur and Ambad MIDC, the auto-component belt, and a growing wine and food-processing sector — keeps up steady demand for site offices, security cabins, and worker rooms. SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd manufactures IS 2062 MS-frame porta cabins at our Greater Noida factory and dispatches them to Nashik in 3 to 5 days. For Nashik's dry-heat-plus-monsoon climate we build with proper insulation, roof sealing, and drainage as standard. Whether you need a security cabin at a Satpur MIDC plot or a multi-room contractor office at a project site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 for specifications and a price.

SAMAN porta cabin site offices delivered to Satpur and Ambad MIDC in 3–5 days.

Why Nashik Buyers Choose SAMAN

The porta cabin listings a Nashik buyer finds online are mostly IndiaMART and TradeIndia directories — supplier cards with no detail on frame grade, panel thickness, or build quality. For a manufacturing city like Nashik, where a cabin may serve a precision auto-component plant or a temperature-sensitive food-processing site, those details decide whether the cabin is fit for use.

SAMAN is the manufacturer. Call us and you reach the team that builds the cabin. Every unit leaves our factory with:

  • IS 2062 Grade A MS hollow-section frame, zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated
  • 50 mm PUF sandwich panels with factory-sealed joints
  • Colour-coated GI roof with proper drainage slope for Nashik's monsoon
  • Pre-wired MCB board with ELCB earthing

We hold ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), plus NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. Started 2009, incorporated 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd (POS = Portable Office Solutions). 500+ projects delivered across India.

Delivery: ₹3,000 standard. Transit to Nashik: 3–5 days from Greater Noida. Returns: 7 days, return freight at buyer's cost.

Nashik's Industries and Porta Cabin Demand

Nashik's mix of heavy manufacturing, agro-processing, and construction generates several types of porta cabin demand:

Satpur MIDC (PIN 422007): Nashik's flagship industrial estate — automobile and auto-component manufacturing, engineering, and defence-sector units. Security cabins at plant gate entries and portable supervisor offices are the most common requirement. The precision-manufacturing environment values a clean, properly built cabin over a site-fabricated one.

Ambad MIDC (PIN 422010): Engineering, electrical, and general manufacturing units. Compact security posts, portable tool stores, and small offices at plot entries are the typical format here.

Wine and food processing: Nashik is India's wine capital, and its grape, onion, and food-processing belt drives demand for portable site offices and quality-check cabins at processing units and cold-storage construction sites.

Construction and infrastructure: Residential development along the Mumbai-Agra Highway (NH-160) corridor, the Nashik-Pune route, and Smart City works generate contractor-office and site-management cabin demand.

Warehousing: Nashik's position on the Mumbai-Nagpur logistics axis is driving new warehouse construction that uses porta cabins as gate and site offices.

We dispatch from Greater Noida via the NH-48 / Madhya Pradesh-Maharashtra corridor — bringing cabins to Nashik in 3–5 days. We serve buyers across Maharashtra, including our porta cabin in Mumbai and porta cabin in Nagpur customers.

Factory-built and quality-checked before despatch to Nashik's industrial zones.

Porta Cabin Specifications

Built for Nashik's dry summer heat, monsoon rainfall, and pleasant winters.

Frame: IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow sections. Welded, zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated, anchor-bolted to an RCC plinth.

Panels: 50 mm PUF sandwich panels standard for thermal comfort across Nashik's seasons. Cement-board panels available for longer-term outdoor industrial use.

Roofing: Colour-coated GI sheet with controlled drainage slope and internal false ceiling. Proper roof sealing matters for Nashik's monsoon — our joints are factory-sealed before despatch.

Flooring: Anti-skid chequered MS plate or commercial-grade laminate. For low-lying or monsoon-exposed sites we recommend a raised RCC plinth to keep floor level above ground water.

Doors and windows: MS frame, powder-coat finish, louvre or sliding windows; fixed glazing on request. All factory-fitted.

Electrical: Pre-wired MCB board, 2–4 power points per room, tube-light provision, ELCB.

Standard sizes: 8×10 ft · 10×12 ft · 10×20 ft · 10×30 ft · 10×40 ft · custom sizes accepted.

Configurations: single room, two-room, multi-room block, with attached toilet/washroom, with pantry.

Applications in Nashik

  • Plant gate security cabins at Satpur and Ambad MIDC plot entries
  • Multi-room contractor offices at construction and warehouse project sites
  • Portable QC and inspection rooms at auto-component and food-processing units
  • Site offices at Mumbai-Agra Highway and Smart City construction stretches
  • Quality-check and supervisor cabins at wine and cold-storage facilities
  • Compact tool stores and supervisor rooms at Ambad engineering units

Porta cabin site offices for Nashik construction and warehouse projects.

Customisation Options

  • Custom dimensions and multi-room layouts
  • RAL colour choice
  • Air-conditioning provision (wall-sleeve cut-out + power point)
  • Turbo ventilator and false ceiling for summer heat
  • Raised RCC plinth for monsoon-exposed or low-lying sites
  • Internal partitions, extra doors/windows
  • Plumbing for attached toilet or washroom
  • Two-storey stacking where load calculations allow

Share your site location and conditions; we confirm specification and price at quotation stage.

Porta Cabin Price in Nashik — Cost Factors

Porta cabin prices in Nashik are not fixed. Each cabin is built to your specification, so the quotation is shaped by a handful of clear factors:

  1. Size — 8×10 ft single room is entry-level; 10×40 ft block is the upper end.
  2. Panel choice — PUF (standard) vs cement-board.
  3. Fit-out — bare shell vs fully fitted (electrical, flooring, paint, AC).
  4. Site additions — raised plinth, extra ventilation, AC provision per your site conditions.
  5. Quantity — 5+ units attract better per-unit pricing. Confirm at quotation.

For an accurate porta cabin price in Nashik for your size and site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937.

Delivery and Installation in Nashik

We dispatch from Greater Noida (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, UP 201308) via the NH-48 corridor on flatbed trucks. Transit: 3–5 days. We arrange dispatch from our North India factory and onward to Nashik on a factory-direct basis. On arrival the cabin is set on your pre-cast RCC plinth, anchor-bolted, panels checked, and the MCB board connected. A single-room cabin is ready within hours; a multi-room block in about a day. Delivery: ₹3,000 standard; confirm consolidated rate for multiple cabins. We have no Nashik warehouse or branch — every cabin is built to order and delivered direct to your site.

How to Order a Porta Cabin in Nashik

Getting a cabin to your Nashik site follows a clear, manufacturer-direct process:

  1. Share your requirement: Tell us the size or floor plan you need, how the cabin will be used — security post, supervisor office, QC room, contractor office, or store — and the exact delivery location, whether a Satpur or Ambad MIDC plot or a project site elsewhere in the Nashik region. A photo or rough sketch of the site helps us plan access and the route in for a flatbed truck.
  2. Get a firm quotation: Our team confirms the specification, panel choice, fit-out level, build timeline, and price for the unit you approve. Because each cabin is built to specification, the quotation reflects your exact build rather than a stock list — there is no fixed per-square-foot rate.
  3. Confirm and prepare the base: Once the order is placed, fabrication begins at our Greater Noida factory. Meanwhile, ready a level base at your site — a concrete plinth, a pre-cast RCC pad, or firm compacted ground — so the unit can be set without delay on arrival.
  4. Delivery and handover: The finished cabin is trucked to Nashik in 3 to 5 days via the NH-48 corridor, positioned on the base, anchor-bolted, panels checked, and connected to its pre-wired electrical board. A single-room unit is typically ready to use within hours of arrival; a multi-room block in about a day.

For larger orders, multi-room blocks, or stacked two-storey site offices, share your site conditions early so our team can plan the structural layout and bolt pattern before dispatch and quote an accurate timeline for your project.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Nashik

Does SAMAN deliver porta cabins to Satpur and Ambad MIDC?

Yes. We deliver to Nashik's industrial zones — Satpur MIDC, Ambad MIDC — and to construction and processing sites across the Nashik region. Transit from our Greater Noida factory is 3–5 days. Delivery charge is ₹3,000 standard.

What is the price of a porta cabin in Nashik?

Price depends on size, panel type, fit-out level, and any site additions such as a raised plinth or AC provision. Call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry for a quotation built for your site and specification. We do not publish fixed prices because every cabin is built to order.

How does a SAMAN porta cabin handle Nashik's monsoon?

Panel joints are factory-sealed before despatch, and the GI roof has a controlled drainage slope so rain runs off cleanly without pooling. For low-lying or monsoon-exposed sites we recommend a raised RCC plinth to keep the floor above ground water. The MS frame is zinc-phosphate primed and powder-coated to resist rust through wet seasons.

Can SAMAN supply porta cabins for a food-processing or precision manufacturing site in Nashik?

Yes. We build clean, factory-finished cabins suitable for QC rooms, supervisor offices, and inspection points at food-processing and auto-component sites. Specifications such as sealed joints, proper flooring, and electrical provisions are confirmed at order stage to suit your site's requirements.

How long does delivery from the factory to Nashik take?

3–5 days from our Greater Noida factory via the NH-48 corridor, after production is complete. Production lead time depends on your configuration and the order queue — confirm at enquiry. Standard sizes move faster.

Get a Porta Cabin in Nashik

For a porta cabin in Nashik delivered to your MIDC plot, processing unit, or construction site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or send an enquiry using the form below. We will respond with the right specification for Nashik's conditions, a delivery timeline, and a firm quotation.
